description:
Unistroke Keyboard is Unistroke Gestural Input Method for General Purpose and Command Line Use – similar to the Graffiti input method which was used by Palm Pilots.
• Left pane for alphabet.
• Right pane for number.
• Tap enters special key mode.
• KEY button shows some useful key buttons.
This is a fork of the original Unistroke Keyboard, with additional features. For details, please see the project's Readme.
